services.name: Admission is
services.desc: The Western Museum of Mining & Industry’s newly unveiled Fluorescent Mineral Display is nothing short of breathtaking-a kaleidoscope of glowing crystals that transport you into an otherworldly realm of color and geology. Each specimen-ranging from electric-blue fluorite to vibrant-green willemite-has been carefully reclassified, cleaned, and remounted to maximize light exposure and visual impact. The installation itself has been entirely reimagined, doubling the display space and improving visibility. Powerful UV lighting ensures every stone shimmers with its own radiant presence. services.name: Miners Pumpkin Patch
services.desc: Almost any day in October, school groups and other organizations can book field trips to the Miners' Pumpkin Patch during the week! Weekday field trips include pumpkin picking, our hay maze, hay slide and our abundance of patch games! For groups under 30 students, Small Group Wednesdays are an excellent option! Small Group Wednesdays run from 10:00 am to 12:00 pm. Showed up for STEM event and left a fan. This museum is not like any other mining museum i had been to.
